about_the_game:
■What you can do in the trial version!

Starting from the first map, "Coast," you can explore the "Wilderness" and "Bamboo Forest." As you discover animals on each map, you can unlock up to 10 chapters of the main story to enjoy. All other functions are available just like in the official version. We would appreciate your comments and feedback. Thank you. *Estimated play time: 1-2 hours. *Data cannot be transferred to the official version. *From MAP 4 onwards, and from story chapter 11 onwards, you can enjoy the official version.

■Explore the mysterious Beast Island! The story takes place on an isolated island in the Pacific Ocean. Gorillas, camels, red pandas, garden eels... One after another, animals that shouldn't be there are discovered. Professor Hitotsubashi, a zoologist, leads an expedition to uncover the secrets hidden on the island. You can enjoy a total of 33 stories, including a huge conspiracy that the expedition members soon become embroiled in, and a prequel that delves into the pasts of the expedition members.

■ Explore a sugoroku-style map! The island's locations, such as the coast, wilderness, and jungle, are represented by a sugoroku game where various events occur. Players choose a number card dealt each turn and move forward across the map the number of times depicted on the card. Depending on the player's choice, various events such as animal discovery events and bad events may occur. The map changes every time you enter, and the cards distributed are also random. You'll need to devise the cards in your hand to advance through your exploration.

■More than 150 types of animals appear! More than 150 types of real animals appear. When an animal is discovered, Professor Hitotsubashi and the other expedition members will casually share animal trivia. In addition, every time you find a certain number of animals, you will acquire skills that will be useful for your exploration. By powering up your expedition, you will be able to venture deeper into the island, where it becomes increasingly harsh.

■Request! I wanted to add too many animals, so I put in too many. I hope you enjoy the game at your own pace, without trying to complete it.

short_description: This is the trial version of "Hitotsubashi Animal Chronicles." This is an adventure game in which you lead an expedition team and aim to "traverse a mysterious island" filled with wild animals and "discover animals." You can explore up to MAP3 and watch up to 10 episodes of the story.
